table.name: shipments
table.summary: A table recording details of individual shipments, linking them to specific orders and invoices with tracking information and timestamps.

shipment_id.name: shipment_id
shipment_id.meaning: A unique identifier for each shipment record within the system.

order_id.name: order_id
order_id.meaning: A reference to the parent order associated with this shipment.

shipment_tracking_number.name: shipment_tracking_number
shipment_tracking_number.meaning: The external tracking number provided by the carrier to monitor the shipment's progress.

other_shipment_details.name: other_shipment_details
other_shipment_details.meaning: Additional free-text information or notes regarding the shipment, currently appearing empty in samples.
